service.title: Service
service.body: Mastrao Visio is Mastrao’s videoconferencing service.

publication.title: Publisher and hosting
publication.body: The Mastrao team still needs to provide the publisher’s legal details, the person responsible for publication and the hosting details for this instance. Contact your Mastrao representative for this information.

upstream.title: Software origin and licenses
upstream.body: Mastrao Visio is adapted from the open source Meet / La Suite Numérique project, originally developed by DINUM and its contributors. This attribution describes the software’s origin.
upstream.license: The original code is distributed under the MIT license with its DINUM/Etalab copyright. Copyright notices and third-party component licenses are preserved in the repository.
